Bill.BriefDescription: Concerning the construction and alteration of ferries.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the construction and alteration of ferries;adding new sections to chapter 47.60 RCW; and repealing RCW 47.60.810,47.60.812, 47.60.814, 47.60.816, 47.60.818, 47.60.820, 47.60.822,47.60.824, and 47.60.8241.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 47.60 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) For any ferry to be acquired by contracts advertised for bidafter August 1, 2013, the department must develop a process forawarding competitively bid contracts for ferry construction projectsusing a design–build procedure. As used in this section, "design–buildprocedure" means a method of contracting under which the departmentcontracts with another party for the party to both design and build theitems specified in the contract. The process developed by thedepartment must, at a minimum, include the scope of services requiredunder the designbuild procedure, contractor prequalificationrequirements, criteria for evaluating technical information and projectcosts, contractor selection criteria, and issue resolution procedures. p. 1 HB 1993 (2)(a) Except as otherwise provided in (b) of this subsection, thedepartment may not participate in or contribute to the design of aferry acquired pursuant to this section. (b) The department may offer a change to the design of a ferry onlywhen the change provides cost savings in the design, construction, oroperation of the ferry and only when the risks associated with thedesign remain exclusively with the contractor.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 47.60 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) In performing pursuant to any contract to construct a ferry,change orders are allowable, but should be used on a very limited basisto accomplish important objectives, including cost savings, safetyimprovements, and operational efficiencies. (2) To accommodate change orders, the department must request thatthe legislative appropriation for any ferry construction projectinclude up to, but no more than, a five percent price contingency.This contingency must be identified in the funding request to thelegislature and held in reserve until the office of financialmanagement approves the expenditure.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 47.60 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: For ferries acquired by the department pursuant to a contractadvertised for bid prior to August 1, 2013, the department may not makeor design a substantial alteration to such ferries unless thedepartment has sought and received approval for the alteration from thelegislature, if the legislature is in session. If the legislature isnot in session, the department must seek and receive approval for suchan alteration from the office of financial management. For thepurposes of this section, "substantial alteration" means any projectthat is anticipated to cost more than twentyfive percent of thereplacement value of the ferry to be altered at the time of alteration.The department may seek to make such an alteration to a ferry only ifthe alteration is necessary to assure continued operation or to provideoperational or longterm cost savings.

The following acts or parts of acts are eachrepealed: RCW 47.60.810 (Designbuild ferriesAuthorizedPhasesdefined) and 2001 c 226 s 4; RCW 47.60.812 (Designbuild ferriesNotice of request forproposals) and 2001 c 226 s 5; RCW 47.60.814 (Designbuild ferriesIssuance of request forproposals) and 2001 c 226 s 6; RCW 47.60.816 (Designbuild ferriesPhase one) and 2001 c 226s 7; RCW 47.60.818 (Designbuild ferriesPhase two) and 2001 c 226s 8; RCW 47.60.820 (Designbuild ferriesPhase three) and 2001 c226 s 9; RCW 47.60.822 (Designbuild ferriesNotice to proposers notselectedAppeal) and 2001 c 226 s 10; RCW 47.60.824 (Designbuild ferriesSingle bestqualifiedproposerIncentivesProposal negotiationsCompensation) and 2007 c481 s 2; and RCW 47.60.8241 (FindingsSingle proposal process for new ferryvessel construction) and 2007 c 481 s 1.
